scenario: No substring keyword predicates per LREG.10.11 — `starts_with` and `ends_with` are not language keywords; regex `~` is the correct predicate form. Pin: regex-based prefix check compiles OK.
rules_ds:
schema Msg scope logical:
    text: String key

rule r:
    Msg m where m.text ~ /^Hello/
->
    log info "starts with Hello"
